The '''1982–83 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 52nd since its establishment. It began on 4 September 1982, and concluded on 1 May 1983. After the penultimate game of the season, [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] led by 1 point but lost in the final game at [[Valencia CF|Valencia]]. The result meant that Valencia avoided relegation on goal difference, while Real Madrid lost the title to [[Athletic Bilbao]] by 1 point.<ref>{{cite web |last=Bort |first=JM |date=13 January 2019 |title=El gol de Tendillo en la tarde de las carambolas |url=https://www.levante-emv.com/valencia-cf/2019/01/13/gol-tendillo-tarde-carambolas-13906628.html |trans-title=Tendillo's goal on the afternoon of flukes |website=[[Levante-EMV]] |language=Spanish |location=Valencia |publisher=[[Prensa Ibérica]] |access-date=1 May 2025}}</ref>
